description: Which of the cards someone holds earns the most on one purchase, at a store (name or website) or in a spending category. Ranks every card given, with its percent back, why, and any cap.

cards.description: Card names or ids the person holds, e.g. "Amex Gold", "Citi Double Cash".

category.description: The spending category, when store is not given or not known.

store.description: A store name or website, e.g. "doordash.com". Used when it is one of the stores PointMaxx knows; otherwise give category.

name: best_card
